hero.title: More Projects
hero.desc: A longer project shelf for experiments, class projects, utilities, and the builds that explain how my C++ / graphics path is growing.

sections.all_projects_desc: Each card links to the detailed project page when one is available, plus the repository for source code.

warships.title: WarShips
warships.desc: A tactical naval game prototype focused on cleaner architecture, reusable systems, and design-pattern practice.

softrenderer.title: SoftRenderer
softrenderer.desc: A CPU-side renderer for rebuilding the graphics pipeline through triangle rasterization, depth testing, and basic shading.

microcomputer.title: 74xx 8-bit Microcomputer
microcomputer.desc: A Turing-complete 8-bit microcomputer built from 74-series TTL chips with a custom ISA, registers, memory, and I/O.

pathfinding.title: PathFindingVisualizer
pathfinding.desc: A visualizer page prepared for grid-search demos, frontier expansion, and final path reconstruction notes.

minesweeper.title: MineSweeper
minesweeper.desc: My first OOP-structured project, with a scene manager, reusable UI components, and multiple game modes.

collegetour.title: CollegeTour
collegetour.desc: A Data Structures group project where I implemented a SQLite-based DataManager and admin credential module.

buttonsdl.title: ButtonForSDL
buttonsdl.desc: A reusable SDL button component extracted and refactored to make interaction logic clearer and easier to maintain.
